name: MCP Billing Gateway
description: Open-source billing infrastructure for MCP server developers — register services, define pricing plans, track per-tool usage, and validate client access tokens with Stripe-backed subscriptions.

inputs.label: Billing Gateway API Key
inputs.description: API key for your MCP Billing Gateway instance. Deploy your own from https://github.com/sapph1re/mcp-billing-gateway-sdk and generate a key via the /admin/keys endpoint.

obtain.instructions:
1. Deploy MCP Billing Gateway from https://github.com/sapph1re/mcp-billing-gateway-sdk
2. Set your ADMIN_API_KEY environment variable
3. POST to /admin/keys to create a client API key
4. Paste the key here

auth.instructions: Requires a Billing Gateway API key. Deploy your own instance from https://github.com/sapph1re/mcp-billing-gateway-sdk, then paste your API key above.
